hooks.command:
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -q 'backend/src/db\.ts$' && printf '
⚠️  backend/src/db.ts was just modified.
Added a column? ensureColumn() should backfill it into backend/taskflow.db automatically on next start -- no action needed.
Renamed/retyped/dropped a column, or changed a CHECK/FOREIGN KEY on an existing one? ALTER TABLE cannot do that in place -- delete backend/taskflow.db* (or run scripts/reset.sh) before restarting.
' >&2 || true
